df7ba879-e624-4357-9823-d8230a5a3bd7.name: Thornwick Cottage
df7ba879-e624-4357-9823-d8230a5a3bd7.concept: An abandoned woodsman's cottage deep in the Whisperwind Forest conceals a sprawling underground complex beneath its rotting floorboards. What appears to be a simple two-room dwelling masks the entrance to forgotten chambers where dark rituals once took place, and restless spirits now guard ancient secrets.

history.origin: Built 80 years ago by Aldric Thornwick, a hermit woodsman who secretly served a cult of shadow druids
history.original_purpose: The cottage served as both a simple dwelling and a hidden entrance to underground ritual chambers used for communion with dark forest spirits
history.downfall: Aldric attempted to bind a powerful shadow fey but lost control, resulting in his death and the corruption of the underground chambers
history.timeline: Abandoned for 15 years after Aldric's mysterious disappearance, now overrun by twisted plants and haunted by malevolent spirits

df7ba879-e624-4357-9823-d8230a5a3bd7.world_context: Located three days' journey into the Whisperwind Forest, far from any settlements, accessible only by overgrown hunting trails
